p: prove Solomon with hard questions at: To know whether his wisdom was as great as the report was.
nothing hid from Solomon which he: There was no question so hard that he did not resolve.
throne: Meaning, that the Israelites were God's peculiar people, and that kings are the lieutenants of God, who ought to grant to him the superiority and administer justice to all.
algum trees and precious stones: Read 2Ch 2:8,1Ki 10:11.
terraces to the house of the: Or pillars: meaning the garnishing and trimming of the stairs or pillars.
beside that which she had brought: That is, which the king gave her for recompense of the treasure which she brought.
six hundred shekels of beaten gold: Which amounts to 2400 crowns of the sun.
Or pounds, called mina, of which every one seemed to make a hundred shekels.
fastened to the throne: That is, the steps and the footstool were fastened to the throne.
stays: Upon the pommels or knops.
Tarshish bringing gold: Which is thought by the best writers to be Cilicia, 1Ki 10:22.
four thousand stalls for horses and: That is, ten horses in every stable, which in all amounts to 40,000 as in 1Ki 4:26.
as stones: The abundance of those temporal treasures in Solomon's kingdom is a figure of the spiritual treasures which the elect will enjoy in the heavens under the true Solomon, Christ.
against Jeroboam the son of Nebat: That is, who prophesied against him.
